_readme: Single place for site-wide values. Human-only fields are blank on purpose. After you buy a domain: set siteOrigin, set originIsPlaceholder to false, then rebuild. See WEBSITE_ARCHITECTURE_AND_UPLOAD_GUIDE.md.
tagline: Time-boxed cleaning routines for small homes
siteDescription: Time-boxed cleaning routines, a minimum day for rough weeks and free printable checklists for renters and busy households in small homes.
